module purpose: neorv32_cpu_icc bridges CSR accesses to an ICC handshake/data interface and a 4-entry XLEN transmit FIFO. It returns ICC status or receive data on csr_rdata_o, asserts icc_tx_o.ack for addressed data reads, and on addressed writes presents csr_wdata_i to the FIFO while also reporting FIFO status.

use-case flows.value: incoming-ready status bit returned in csr_rdata_o(0) when the ICC status CSR address branch is selected
FIFO status bit returned in csr_rdata_o(1) when the ICC status CSR address branch is selected
received ICC data word returned on csr_rdata_o when the ICC data CSR address branch is selected and icc_rx_i.rdy is high
acknowledgment event driven on icc_tx_o.ack for an addressed CSR read of the ICC data register
write-acceptance decision for enqueuing a CSR write word into the transmit FIFO
CSR write word presented to the connected transmit FIFO input under the write-acceptance decision

conceptual assets.concept: Incoming-data ready status bit exposed through the CSR read path
conceptual assets.reasoning: The read path clears csr_rdata_o at line 45, selects the ICC CSR region at lines 46-47, and then copies the input status bit with `csr_rdata_o(0) <= icc_rx_i.rdy;` at line 48. The same input also qualifies data return at lines 51-52. Integrity is established because both the reported status bit and the read qualification become incorrect if this value is corrupted; availability is conditional on the addressed read branch.

conceptual assets.concept: Transmit-buffer status bit exposed through the CSR read path
conceptual assets.reasoning: When the status-read branch is selected at lines 46-47, the module reports `tx_fifo_free` with `csr_rdata_o(1) <= tx_fifo_free;` at line 49. That status value is received from the FIFO sub-unit on `free_o => tx_fifo_free` at line 83. Integrity is established because the CSR status report depends on this exact sub-unit output; availability is conditional on the addressed status-read branch.

conceptual assets.concept: Received ICC data word exposed through the CSR read path
conceptual assets.reasoning: In the data-read branch at line 50, the module returns a word only when `icc_rx_i.rdy = '1'` at line 51, and then drives `csr_rdata_o <= icc_rx_i.dat;` at line 52. Integrity is established because the addressed read result must equal the input word under that RTL-visible condition; availability is conditional on the addressed data-read branch and `icc_rx_i.rdy = '1'`.

conceptual assets.concept: Read-acknowledgment event generated toward the ICC interface
conceptual assets.reasoning: The module computes the outgoing event only from the addressed read predicate: `icc_tx_o.ack <= '1' when (csr_re_i = '1') and (csr_addr_i = csr_mxiccdata_c) else '0';` at line 59. Integrity is established because transfer sequencing through this output becomes incorrect if the event is asserted at the wrong time or omitted when the predicate holds; availability is conditional on that same predicate.

The module computes `tx_fifo_we` only from the addressed write predicate at line 60, and delivers that decision to the connected FIFO with `we_i => tx_fifo_we` at line 82. Integrity is established because enqueue acceptance becomes incorrect if this decision no longer matches `(csr_we_i = '1') and (csr_addr_i = csr_mxiccdata_c)`; availability is conditional on that predicate.

conceptual assets.concept: CSR write word delivered to the connected transmit FIFO input
conceptual assets.reasoning: The transmit data flow presents `csr_wdata_i` directly to the FIFO sub-unit with `wdata_i => csr_wdata_i` at line 81, while line 82 supplies the separate write-acceptance decision. Under the RTL-visible condition that the write decision is asserted, integrity is established by the boundary-delivery rule: the connected consumer must receive exactly this XLEN word. Availability is conditional on `tx_fifo_we`.
